title: 『スクジサマ』を巡る考察
description:
From the Editorial DepartmentWe would like to provide a brief explanation of this work.

This work is a digital piece left behind by our writer, Yosuke Kuga.

During his lifetime, Kuga was engaged in research, interviews, and writing primarily in the fields of the occult and Japanese folklore.

He had ceased his writing activities several months prior to his death and was subsequently found deceased at his residence.

No editor received any explanation from Kuga regarding this work, and we have been unable to determine when it was created or when it was completed. As such, it is unclear how far the work had progressed at the time.

Permission to publish this work has been formally obtained from his surviving family.

The work consists primarily of a long-form novel, supplemented by exploration of 3D environments, various materials including images, audio, video, and documents, as well as questions requiring the reader to draw their own conclusions.

By examining the materials contained within the work, cross-referencing the information they contain, and developing theories based on the evidence, the full story will gradually begin to reveal itself.

Whenever possible, the materials included in this work have been preserved in the condition in which they were discovered. Some files are damaged, while the original viewing order of certain materials cannot be determined. Nevertheless, we have judged these elements to be part of the work itself and have kept editorial intervention to a minimum.

As a special benefit for our shareholders, we are making this work available to them in advance of its general release.

The editorial department has conducted a review of the contents prior to release. However, due to the extremely large volume of data and the nature of the work, we have been unable to examine every piece of material in its entirety.

Should you discover any information that may be unsuitable for general release, content that may infringe upon the rights of a third party, or any other material that you believe may present an issue, we kindly ask that you contact our company.

Only when deemed necessary will we consider making corrections, deletions, or replacements in future versions of the work.

Furthermore, with regard to any events or phenomena that may occur during or after viewing this work, our company is unable to verify any causal relationship between such events and the work itself. We ask that you please understand this in advance.

ControlsThis work is designed to be played using a keyboard and mouse.

Certain sections require you to explore the environment using a keyboard and mouse.

Video StreamingThere are no particular restrictions regarding the streaming or recording of this work.

You are free to share gameplay videos, livestreams, commentary, and other related content as you would with a conventional game.

With this, the editorial department's additions and supplementary information regarding this work come to an end.

All content presented from this point onward has been preserved in the condition in which it was discovered.

And now, we invite you to experience the work left behind by Yosuke Kuga.
description_short: This work is structured around a full-length novel and consists of exploration of a 3D space, various materials such as images, audio, video, and documents, and questions that require careful consideration.
